name: Rosina Velte

events.place: St. Joseph's Hospital, Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada

notes: Refer letter from M.Minster 7/1/1997.She states that her G'mother,Rosina Velte departed from Antwerp aboard the "Lake Michigan" but doesn't know the port of arrival-but presumably, NY.This letter also implies that Rosina,her 16 yr old sister & the 3 oldest boys(Alfred,Julius & next eldest)went through the woods from Ukraine to Poland then by train to Antwerp.Suggested date is March 1907.
